title: SoulPlugin
description: Soul System: Every player has a soul! PvP kills drop player souls, which can be collected, traded, or used to revive players. Soulless players are trapped in the Nether until revived at the Soul Graveyard (Glow Item Frame). Includes admin commands to set
body:
Soul System — Minecraft Plugin/Mod

Every player has a soul! Souls are powerful, rare, and essential to survive the dangers of the world.

Features

Player Souls: Dropped when a player is killed by another player (Soul of <PlayerName>).

Artificial Souls: Crafted or purchased and named Artificial Soul of <PlayerName>.

Soul Graveyard: A protected Glow Item Frame where souls are placed to revive players.

Nether Prison: Players who lose their soul are trapped in the Nether until revived.

PvP Mechanics: Killing players drops their real soul, which can be picked up for revival, trading, or buffs.

Revival: Right-click the Glow Item Frame with the correct soul:

⚡ Lightning effect

🔊 Portal sound

📢 Broadcast message

Player respawns at spawn

Admin Commands

/soul graveyard set → Bind the Glow Item Frame as the Soul Graveyard

/soul netherspawn set → Set Nether Prison spawn for soulless players

/soul give @ artificial gives artificial soul of a person
Requires OP or soul.admin permission.

💡 Quick TL;DR:
Souls = Ghast Tear with Soul Speed 10 → PvP kills drop player souls → Use Glow Item Frame to revive → Soulless players trapped in Nether until revival.

Crafting recipe for artificial souls
* 8 diamond block surrounding a ghast tear
* Artificial Soul of [playername]
* Make sure format is perfect
